steps: In an isolated git archive of the reviewed SHA, remove public/terrain/engravings/dunes.png and only the dunes key from src/rendering/engravingCatalog.json. Leave MANUAL_BIOMES.dunes registered.
Run npm run build, then initialize the actual App via test/helpers/generation-harness.mjs.
findings.observed: Build succeeded, verified 35 PNGs and emitted index.html. App initialization throws TypeError Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'color'). A PNG-only omission fails with ENOENT and a replacement is correctly rejected on SHA-256.
findings.expected: Required manual biome artwork missing from the catalog must abort the ordinary build before Vite. Retain the existing file and hash failures.
findings.impact: The commit contains the correct asset. Its build guard permits shipping an application that fails at startup when an asset and its catalog record are omitted together.
